social workers in the three local authorities we studied have embraced care management and are actively seeking to incorporate its principles and values into their practice.

how care management is being interpreted in social work practice.
the way in which social workers are adapting their professional practice to accommodate the requirements of care management and the way in which this is impacting upon their professional identity.
the way social workers are adapting and redefining their professional identity in the light of the introduction of care management.

social workers are embracing the new care management role.
social workers are not resistant to change but rather that they are actively engaged in the process of change.

the social worker has become a care manager.
social workers are adapting to the changes in their work roles and are actively trying to incorporate the principles and practice of care management into the way they work.

social work is a dynamic profession, which adapts and changes to meet the needs of service users and the wider society.
